Thus it appears that while the phrasing of Conclusio xxix was inspired by the Bahir, its location reflects the arrangement of the subject matter in Recanati. Another case in point is Conclusio xli. It treats of new souls and its source is the Bahir, either directly or indirectly through the quotation in Recanati at fol. 9va.
